description: Returns the full detail for one action in the bank of 30: its life area and feeling, the first move for week one, the resolution at all three time levels (30 minutes, 2 hours, and 5 hours a week), the guard line for each kind of past failure, and up to 3 similar actions. Accepts an action id or name from pick_resolution or search_resolutions, or an area plus a feeling. When nothing matches, the result says so and gives example ids.

area.description: Optional, with off: one life area, e.g. 'health' or 'home'.

off.description: Optional, with area: one feeling, e.g. 'drained' or 'stuck'.

resolution_id.description: Action id from pick_resolution or search_resolutions (e.g. 'take-a-short-walk'), or an action name like 'take a short walk'.

name: get_resolution
title: Get resolution details
